idea-plugin.name: AI Commit Message Generator for IntelliJ
idea-plugin.description:
Generate Conventional Commit messages from the changes selected in IntelliJ IDEA's Commit tool window.

CommitMuse turns the diff you are about to commit into a clear, editable commit message and writes it directly into the Commit Message field.

Highlights

  • Uses the changes you selected: reads tracked and untracked files checked in the Commit tool window.
  • Writes as it generates: streams the response into the Commit Message field so you can review it immediately.
  • Produces structured messages: the default prompt creates a Conventional Commits title plus a concise change list with matching emoji.
  • Works in multiple languages: generate commit messages in Chinese, English, or Japanese.
  • Lets you stay in control: customize the prompt template, test the connection, and stop an in-progress generation from the toolbar.
  • Supports your own provider: configure a Chat Completions-compatible endpoint, model, and API key.

Quick start

  1. Open Settings | Tools | AI Commit Message.
  2. Enter your endpoint, model, and API key, then use Test Connection.
  3. Open the Commit tool window, select the changes to include, and click the M icon.

If the action is invoked outside the Commit tool window, the plugin uses the staged Git diff and copies the generated message to the clipboard.

Privacy

The selected Git diff and prompt are sent only to the AI endpoint you configure. Your API key is stored in IntelliJ IDEA's local non-roaming settings. Review your provider's data policy before sending proprietary code.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 or later
  • Built-in Git integration enabled
  • A Chat Completions-compatible API endpoint and API key

中文说明

根据 IntelliJ IDEA 提交窗口中勾选的代码变更生成 Conventional Commits 提交信息，并以流式方式直接写入提交信息输入框。

  • 支持已跟踪文件、未跟踪文件，以及非提交窗口场景下的 Git 暂存区差异。
  • 支持中文、英文、日文，可自定义提示词模板。
  • 支持兼容 Chat Completions API 的自定义服务地址和模型。
  • 可在设置页检测连接；生成过程中再次点击红色停止图标即可取消。

注意：所选 Git Diff 与提示词会发送到你配置的 AI 服务，请在处理私有代码前确认服务方的数据政策。
